verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּעַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֔ב מֵעֵ֖בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·‘ar·ḇō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ mê·‘ê·ḇer lə·yar·dên yə·rê·ḥōw
verses.literal: Then the Israelites . . . traveled on and camped in the plains of Moab near the Jordan across from Jericho
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido os filhos de Israel, acamparam-se nas planícies de Moabe, além do Jordão, na altura de Jericó.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא בָּלָ֖ק בֶּן־ צִפּ֑וֹר אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָֽאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar bā·lāq ben- ṣip·pō·wr ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh yiś·rā·’êl lā·’ĕ·mō·rî
verses.literal: Now Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites
verses.literalPt: Balaque, filho de Zipor, viu tudo o que Israel fizera aos amorreus.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨גָר מוֹאָ֜ב מִפְּנֵ֥י הָעָ֛ם מְאֹ֖ד כִּ֣י רַב־ ה֑וּא וַיָּ֣קָץ מוֹאָ֔ב מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḡār mō·w·’āḇ mip·pə·nê hā·‘ām mə·’ōḏ kî raḇ- hū way·yā·qāṣ mō·w·’āḇ mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: and Moab was terrified of the people . . . because they were numerous Indeed, Moab . . . dreaded the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Moabe tinha grande medo do povo, porque era muito, e estava angustiado por causa dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מוֹאָ֜ב אֶל־ זִקְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עַתָּ֞ה יְלַחֲכ֤וּ הַקָּהָל֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ סְבִ֣יבֹתֵ֔ינוּ כִּלְחֹ֣ךְ הַשּׁ֔וֹר אֵ֖ת יֶ֣רֶק הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּבָלָ֧ק בֶּן־ צִפּ֛וֹר מֶ֥לֶךְ לְמוֹאָ֖ב בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·w·’āḇ ’el- ziq·nê miḏ·yān ‘at·tāh yə·la·ḥă·ḵū haq·qā·hāl ’eṯ- kāl- sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯê·nū kil·ḥōḵ haš·šō·wr ’êṯ ye·req haś·śā·ḏeh ū·ḇā·lāq ben- ṣip·pō·wr me·leḵ lə·mō·w·’āḇ bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w
verses.literal: So the Moabites said to the elders of Midian . . . This horde will devour everything around us as an ox licks up the grass of the field Since Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time
verses.literalPt: Disse aos anciãos de Midiã: Agora, esta multidão roerá tudo quanto estiver ao redor de nós, como o boi rói as ervas do campo. Nesse tempo, Balaque, filho de Zipor, era rei de Moabe.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח מַלְאָכִ֜ים אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ בְּע֗וֹר פְּ֠תוֹרָה אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל־ הַנָּהָ֛ר אֶ֥רֶץ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֖וֹ לִקְרֹא־ ל֑וֹ לֵאמֹ֗ר הִ֠נֵּה עַ֣ם יָצָ֤א מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ הִנֵּ֤ה כִסָּה֙ אֶת־ עֵ֣ין הָאָ֔רֶץ וְה֥וּא יֹשֵׁ֖ב מִמֻּלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- bil·‘ām ben- bə·‘ō·wr pə·ṯō·w·rāh ’ă·šer ‘al- han·nā·hār ’e·reṣ bə·nê- ‘am·mōw liq·rō- lōw lê·mōr hin·nêh ‘am yā·ṣā mim·miṣ·ra·yim hin·nêh ḵis·sāh ’eṯ- ‘ên hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hū yō·šêḇ mim·mu·lî
verses.literal: he sent messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor at Pethor which is by the Euphrates in the land of his people . . . Behold a people has come out of Egypt said Balak - They cover the face of the land . . . and have settled next to me
verses.literalPt: Enviou mensageiros a Balaão, filho de Beor, a Petor, que está junto ao rio, à terra dos filhos do seu povo, a chamá-lo, dizendo: Eis que um povo saiu do Egito, cobre a face da terra e estaciona defronte de mim.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֩ לְכָה־ נָּ֨א אָֽרָה־ לִּ֜י אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה כִּֽי־ עָצ֥וּם הוּא֙ מִמֶּ֔נִּי אוּלַ֤י אוּכַל֙ נַכֶּה־ בּ֔וֹ וַאֲגָרְשֶׁ֖נּוּ מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ תְּבָרֵךְ֙ מְבֹרָ֔ךְ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּאֹ֖ר יוּאָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lə·ḵāh- nā ’ā·rāh- lî ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh kî- ‘ā·ṣūm hū mim·men·nî ’ū·lay ’ū·ḵal nak·keh- bōw wa·’ă·ḡā·rə·šen·nū min- hā·’ā·reṣ kî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- tə·ḇā·rêḵ mə·ḇō·rāḵ wa·’ă·šer tā·’ōr yū·’ār
verses.literal: So please come now and put a curse on this people because they are too mighty for me Perhaps I may be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land for I know that those you bless are blessed and those you curse are cursed
verses.literalPt: Vem, agora, amaldiçoar-me a este povo; porque é mais forte do que eu; porventura, prevalecerei, de modo que eu o fira e o expulse da terra; pois sei que será abençoado aquele a quem abençoares, e amaldiçoado, aquele a quem amaldiçoares.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ זִקְנֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ וְזִקְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֔ן וּקְסָמִ֖ים בְּיָדָ֑ם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו דִּבְרֵ֥י בָלָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū ziq·nê mō·w·’āḇ wə·ziq·nê miḏ·yān ū·qə·sā·mîm bə·yā·ḏām way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- bil·‘ām way·ḏab·bə·rū ’ê·lāw diḇ·rê ḇā·lāq
verses.literal: The elders of Moab . . . and Midian departed with the fees for divination in hand They came to Balaam and relayed to him the words of Balak
verses.literalPt: Partiram os anciãos de Moabe e os anciãos de Midiã, levando nas mãos com que pagar os encantamentos; foram a Balaão e referiram-lhe as palavras de Balaque.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לִ֤ינוּ פֹה֙ הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי־ מוֹאָ֖ב עִם־ בִּלְעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem lî·nū p̄ōh hal·lay·lāh wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem dā·ḇār ka·’ă·šer yə·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’ê·lāy way·yê·šə·ḇū śā·rê- mō·w·’āḇ ‘im- bil·‘ām
verses.literal: Spend the night here Balaam replied . . . and I will give you the answer that the LORD speaks to me So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam
verses.literalPt: Ele lhes respondeu: Ficai aqui esta noite, e vos trarei a resposta que Jeová me der; os príncipes de Moabe ficaram com Balaão.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֛י הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- bil·‘ām way·yō·mer mî hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Then God came to Balaam and asked Who are these men with you
verses.literalPt: Veio Deus a Balaão e perguntou-lhe: Quem são estes homens que estão contigo?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר בִּלְעָ֖ם אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּלָ֧ק בֶּן־ צִפֹּ֛ר מֶ֥לֶךְ מוֹאָ֖ב שָׁלַ֥ח אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bil·‘ām ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bā·lāq ben- ṣip·pōr me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ šā·laḥ ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: And Balaam said to God Balak son of Zippor king of Moab sent me this message
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Balaão a Deus: Balaque, filho de Zipor, rei de Moabe, os enviou, para que me dissessem:

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הָעָם֙ הַיֹּצֵ֣א מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וַיְכַ֖ס אֶת־ עֵ֣ין הָאָ֑רֶץ עַתָּ֗ה לְכָ֤ה קָֽבָה־ לִּי֙ אֹת֔וֹ אוּלַ֥י אוּכַ֛ל לְהִלָּ֥חֶם בּ֖וֹ וְגֵרַשְׁתִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh hā·‘ām hay·yō·ṣê mim·miṣ·ra·yim way·ḵas ’eṯ- ‘ên hā·’ā·reṣ ‘at·tāh lə·ḵāh qā·ḇāh- lî ’ō·ṯōw ’ū·lay ’ū·ḵal lə·hil·lā·ḥem bōw wə·ḡê·raš·tîw
verses.literal: Behold a people has come out of Egypt and they cover the face of the land Now come and put a curse on them for me Perhaps I may be able to fight against them and drive them away
verses.literalPt: Eis que o povo que saiu do Egito cobre a face da terra; vem, agora, amaldiçoar-mo; talvez assim poderei pelejar contra ele e expulsá-lo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם לֹ֥א תֵלֵ֖ךְ עִמָּהֶ֑ם לֹ֤א תָאֹר֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י בָר֖וּךְ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- bil·‘ām lō ṯê·lêḵ ‘im·mā·hem lō ṯā·’ōr ’eṯ- hā·‘ām kî ḇā·rūḵ hū
verses.literal: But God said to Balaam Do not go with them You are not to curse this people for they are blessed
verses.literalPt: Tornou Deus a Balaão: Não irás com eles; não amaldiçoarás o povo, porque é bendito.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קָם בִּלְעָם֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ שָׂרֵ֣י בָלָ֔ק לְכ֖וּ אֶֽל־ אַרְצְכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י מֵאֵ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה לְתִתִּ֖י לַהֲלֹ֥ךְ עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām bil·‘ām bab·bō·qer way·yō·mer ’el- śā·rê ḇā·lāq lə·ḵū ’el- ’ar·ṣə·ḵem kî mê·’ên Yah·weh lə·ṯit·tî la·hă·lōḵ ‘im·mā·ḵem
verses.literal: So Balaam got up the next morning and said to Balak’s princes Go back to your homeland because the LORD has refused to let me go with you
verses.literalPt: Levantando-se Balaão pela manhã, disse aos príncipes de Balaque: Ide para a vossa terra, porque Jeová recusa deixar-me ir convosco.

verses.original: וַיָּק֙וּמוּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ בָּלָ֑ק וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵאֵ֥ן בִּלְעָ֖ם הֲלֹ֥ךְ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qū·mū śā·rê mō·w·’āḇ way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- bā·lāq way·yō·mə·rū mê·’ên bil·‘ām hă·lōḵ ‘im·mā·nū
verses.literal: And the princes of Moab arose returned to Balak and said Balaam refused to come with us
verses.literalPt: Tendo-se levantado os príncipes de Moabe, voltaram a Balaque e disseram: Balaão recusou vir conosco.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥סֶף ע֖וֹד בָּלָ֑ק שְׁלֹ֣חַ שָׂרִ֔ים רַבִּ֥ים וְנִכְבָּדִ֖ים מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ ‘ō·wḏ bā·lāq šə·lō·aḥ śā·rîm rab·bîm wə·niḵ·bā·ḏîm mê·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Then Balak sent other princes . . . more numerous and more distinguished than the first messengers
verses.literalPt: Tornou Balaque a enviar príncipes em maior número e de maior qualidade do que aqueles,

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֗וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ בָּלָ֣ק בֶּן־ צִפּ֔וֹר אַל־ נָ֥א תִמָּנַ֖ע מֵהֲלֹ֥ךְ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- bil·‘ām way·yō·mə·rū lōw kōh ’ā·mar bā·lāq ben- ṣip·pō·wr ’al- nā ṯim·mā·na‘ mê·hă·lōḵ ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: They came to Balaam and said This is what Balak son of Zippor says Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me
verses.literalPt: os quais, chegando a Balaão, lhe disseram: Assim diz Balaque, filho de Zipor: Não te demores em vir a mim,

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כַבֵּ֤ד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלַ֖י אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֑ה וּלְכָה־ נָּא֙ קָֽבָה־ לִּ֔י אֵ֖ת הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵab·bêḏ ’ă·ḵab·beḏ·ḵā mə·’ōḏ wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tō·mar ’ê·lay ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ū·lə·ḵāh- nā qā·ḇāh- lî ’êṯ hā·‘ām haz·zeh
verses.literal: for I will honor you richly . . . and do whatever you say . . . So please come and put a curse on this people for me
verses.literalPt: porque grandemente te honrarei e farei tudo o que me disseres. Vem, pois, amaldiçoar-me este povo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַן בִּלְעָ֗ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ עַבְדֵ֣י בָלָ֔ק אִם־ יִתֶּן־ לִ֥י בָלָ֛ק מְלֹ֥א בֵית֖וֹ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב לֹ֣א אוּכַ֗ל לַעֲבֹר֙ אֶת־ פִּי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת קְטַנָּ֖ה א֥וֹ גְדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an bil·‘ām way·yō·mer ’el- ‘aḇ·ḏê ḇā·lāq ’im- yit·ten- lî ḇā·lāq mə·lō ḇê·ṯōw ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ lō ’ū·ḵal la·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy la·‘ă·śō·wṯ qə·ṭan·nāh ’ōw ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh
verses.literal: But Balaam . . . replied to the servants of Balak If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold I could not do anything small or great to go beyond the command of the LORD my God
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Balaão aos servos de Balaque: Se Balaque me desse a sua casa cheia de prata e de ouro, eu não poderia ir além da ordem de Jeová, meu Deus, para fazer coisa alguma grande ou pequena.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה שְׁב֨וּ נָ֥א בָזֶ֛ה גַּם־ אַתֶּ֖ם הַלָּ֑יְלָה וְאֵ֣דְעָ֔ה מַה־ יֹּסֵ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה דַּבֵּ֥ר עִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ḇū nā ḇā·zeh gam- ’at·tem hal·lā·yə·lāh wə·’ê·ḏə·‘āh mah- yō·sêp̄ Yah·weh dab·bêr ‘im·mî
verses.literal: So now please stay here overnight as the others did . . . that I may find out what else the LORD has to tell me . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, rogo-vos que fiqueis aqui também esta noite, para que eu saiba o que Jeová me falar mais.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א אֱלֹהִ֥ים׀ אֶל־ בִּלְעָם֮ לַיְלָה֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אִם־ לִקְרֹ֤א לְךָ֙ בָּ֣אוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים ק֖וּם לֵ֣ךְ אִתָּ֑ם וְאַ֗ךְ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ אֹת֥וֹ תַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- bil·‘ām lay·lāh way·yō·mer lōw ’im- liq·rō lə·ḵā bā·’ū hā·’ă·nā·šîm qūm lêḵ ’it·tām wə·’aḵ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’ê·le·ḵā ’ō·ṯōw ṯa·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: That night God came to Balaam and said Since these men have come to summon you get up and go with them but you must only - do what I tell you . . .
verses.literalPt: Veio Deus a Balaão de noite e disse-lhe: Se os homens te vierem chamar, levanta-te, vai com eles; mas somente aquilo que eu te falar, isso farás.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קָם בִּלְעָם֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַֽיַּחֲבֹ֖שׁ אֶת־ אֲתֹנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ עִם־ שָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām bil·‘ām bab·bō·qer way·ya·ḥă·ḇōš ’eṯ- ’ă·ṯō·nōw way·yê·leḵ ‘im- śā·rê mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: So in the morning Balaam got up saddled his donkey and went with the princes of Moab
verses.literalPt: Levantou-se Balaão pela manhã, albardou a sua jumenta e partiu com os príncipes de Moabe.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֣ף אֱלֹהִים֮ כִּֽי־ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ הוּא֒ וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֞ב מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ לְשָׂטָ֣ן ל֑וֹ וְהוּא֙ רֹכֵ֣ב עַל־ אֲתֹנ֔וֹ וּשְׁנֵ֥י נְעָרָ֖יו עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî- hō·w·lêḵ hū way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ mal·’aḵ Yah·weh bad·de·reḵ lə·śā·ṭān lōw wə·hū rō·ḵêḇ ‘al- ’ă·ṯō·nōw ū·šə·nê nə·‘ā·rāw ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: Then God’s anger was kindled because Balaam was going along and the angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him Balaam was riding . . . his donkey and his two servants were with him
verses.literalPt: Acendeu-se a ira de Deus, porque ele ia; e o Anjo de Jeová pôs-se-lhe no caminho por adversário. Ora, Balaão ia montado na sua jumenta e tinha dois servos consigo.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣רֶא הָאָתוֹן֩ אֶת־ מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה נִצָּ֣ב בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ וְחַרְבּ֤וֹ שְׁלוּפָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וַתֵּ֤ט הָֽאָתוֹן֙ מִן־ הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ בִּלְעָם֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אָת֔וֹן לְהַטֹּתָ֖הּ הַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re hā·’ā·ṯō·wn ’eṯ- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh niṣ·ṣāḇ bad·de·reḵ wə·ḥar·bōw šə·lū·p̄āh bə·yā·ḏōw wat·têṭ hā·’ā·ṯō·wn min- had·de·reḵ wat·tê·leḵ baś·śā·ḏeh way·yaḵ bil·‘ām ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ṯō·wn lə·haṭ·ṭō·ṯāh had·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand she turned off the path and went into a field So Balaam beat her to return her to the path
verses.literalPt: A jumenta viu o Anjo parado no caminho, com a sua espada desembainhada na mão, desviou-se do caminho e ia pelo campo; Balaão fustigou-a para fazê-la tornar ao caminho.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה בְּמִשְׁע֖וֹל הַכְּרָמִ֑ים גָּדֵ֥ר מִזֶּ֖ה וְגָדֵ֥ר מִזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ mal·’aḵ Yah·weh bə·miš·‘ō·wl hak·kə·rā·mîm gā·ḏêr miz·zeh wə·ḡā·ḏêr miz·zeh
verses.literal: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow passage between two vineyards with walls on either side . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, o Anjo de Jeová parou numa azinhaga, entre as vinhas, com uma sebe num e noutro lado.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֨רֶא הָאָת֜וֹן אֶת־ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה וַתִּלָּחֵץ֙ אֶל־ הַקִּ֔יר וַתִּלְחַ֛ץ אֶת־ רֶ֥גֶל בִּלְעָ֖ם אֶל־ הַקִּ֑יר וַיֹּ֖סֶף לְהַכֹּתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re hā·’ā·ṯō·wn ’eṯ- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh wat·til·lā·ḥêṣ ’el- haq·qîr wat·til·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- re·ḡel bil·‘ām ’el- haq·qîr way·yō·sep̄ lə·hak·kō·ṯāh
verses.literal: And the donkey saw the angel of the LORD and pressed herself against the wall crushing Balaam’s foot against it So he beat her once again
verses.literalPt: Vendo a jumenta o Anjo de Jeová, coseu-se com o muro e comprimiu o pé de Balaão contra o muro; ele a tornou a fustigar.

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹסֶף מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֖ה עֲב֑וֹר וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ בְּמָק֣וֹם צָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵֽין־ דֶּ֥רֶךְ לִנְט֖וֹת יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·sep̄ mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh ‘ă·ḇō·wr way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ bə·mā·qō·wm ṣār ’ă·šer ’ên- de·reḵ lin·ṭō·wṯ yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl
verses.literal: And the angel of the LORD moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn to the right or left
verses.literalPt: O Anjo de Jeová passou mais adiante, e parou num lugar estreito, onde não era possível desviar-se nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤רֶא הָֽאָתוֹן֙ אֶת־ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וַתִּרְבַּ֖ץ תַּ֣חַת בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֣ף בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ הָאָת֖וֹן בַּמַּקֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re hā·’ā·ṯō·wn ’eṯ- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh wat·tir·baṣ ta·ḥaṯ bil·‘ām way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ bil·‘ām way·yaḵ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ṯō·wn bam·maq·qêl
verses.literal: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD she lay down under Balaam and he became furious . . . and beat her with his staff
verses.literalPt: Vendo a jumenta o Anjo de Jeová, deitou-se debaixo de Balaão; acendeu-se a ira de Balaão, e fustigou a jumenta com a sua vara.

verses.original: וַיִּפְתַּ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ פִּ֣י הָאָת֑וֹן וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לְבִלְעָם֙ מֶה־ עָשִׂ֣יתִֽי לְךָ֔ כִּ֣י הִכִּיתַ֔נִי זֶ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ רְגָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·taḥ Yah·weh ’eṯ- pî hā·’ā·ṯō·wn wat·tō·mer lə·ḇil·‘ām meh- ‘ā·śî·ṯî lə·ḵā kî hik·kî·ṯa·nî zeh šā·lōš rə·ḡā·lîm
verses.literal: Then the LORD opened the donkey’s mouth and she said to Balaam What have I done to you that you have beaten me these three times
verses.literalPt: Então, Jeová abriu a boca da jumenta, e ela perguntou a Balaão: Que te fiz eu para que me fustigasses estas três vezes?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ לָֽאָת֔וֹן כִּ֥י הִתְעַלַּ֖לְתְּ בִּ֑י ל֤וּ יֶשׁ־ חֶ֙רֶב֙ בְּיָדִ֔י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה הֲרַגְתִּֽיךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bil·‘ām lā·’ā·ṯō·wn kî hiṯ·‘al·lalt bî lū yeš- ḥe·reḇ bə·yā·ḏî kî ‘at·tāh hă·raḡ·tîḵ
verses.literal: Balaam answered the donkey . . . You have made a fool of me If I had a sword in my hand . . . I would kill you right now
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Balaão à jumenta: Porque zombaste de mim; oxalá tivesse eu uma espada na mão, pois eu te haveria matado.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר הָאָת֜וֹן אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֗ם הֲלוֹא֩ אָנֹכִ֨י אֲתֹֽנְךָ֜ אֲשֶׁר־ רָכַ֣בְתָּ עָלַ֗י מֵעֽוֹדְךָ֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה הַֽהַסְכֵּ֣ן הִסְכַּ֔נְתִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְךָ֖ כֹּ֑ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hā·’ā·ṯō·wn ’el- bil·‘ām hă·lō·w ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ṯō·nə·ḵā ’ă·šer- rā·ḵaḇ·tā ‘ā·lay mê·‘ō·wḏ·ḵā ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ha·has·kên his·kan·tî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lə·ḵā kōh way·yō·mer lō
verses.literal: But the donkey . . . said to Balaam Am I not the donkey you have ridden . . . all your life until today . . . . . . Have I ever treated you this way before . . . No he replied
verses.literalPt: Tornou a jumenta a Balaão: Acaso, não sou a tua jumenta, em que cavalgaste toda a tua vida até hoje? Porventura, tem sido o meu costume fazer-te coisa semelhante? Ele respondeu: Não.

verses.original: וַיְגַ֣ל יְהוָה֮ אֶת־ עֵינֵ֣י בִלְעָם֒ וַיַּ֞רְא אֶת־ מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ נִצָּ֣ב בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְחַרְבּ֥וֹ שְׁלֻפָ֖ה בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיִּקֹּ֥ד וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לְאַפָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḡal Yah·weh ’eṯ- ‘ê·nê ḇil·‘ām way·yar ’eṯ- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh niṣ·ṣāḇ bad·de·reḵ wə·ḥar·bōw šə·lu·p̄āh bə·yā·ḏōw way·yiq·qōḏ way·yiš·ta·ḥū lə·’ap·pāw
verses.literal: Then the LORD opened Balaam’s eyes and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand And Balaam bowed low . . . and fell facedown
verses.literalPt: Então, abriu Jeová os olhos de Balaão, e ele viu o Anjo de Jeová parado no caminho, com a sua espada desembainhada na mão; inclinou a cabeça e prostrou-se com o rosto em terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ מָ֗ה הִכִּ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ אֲתֹ֣נְךָ֔ זֶ֖ה שָׁל֣וֹשׁ רְגָלִ֑ים הִנֵּ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ יָצָ֣אתִי לְשָׂטָ֔ן כִּֽי־ יָרַ֥ט הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ לְנֶגְדִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ‘al- māh hik·kî·ṯā ’eṯ- ’ă·ṯō·nə·ḵā zeh šā·lō·wōš rə·ḡā·lîm hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî yā·ṣā·ṯî lə·śā·ṭān kî- yā·raṭ had·de·reḵ lə·neḡ·dî
verses.literal: The angel of the LORD asked him . . . Why . . . have you beaten your donkey these three times Behold I have come out to oppose you because your way is perverse before me
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe o Anjo de Jeová: Por que fustigaste a tua jumenta estas três vezes? Eis que eu saí como adversário, porque o teu caminho é perverso diante de mim.

verses.original: וַתִּרְאַ֙נִי֙ הָֽאָת֔וֹן וַתֵּ֣ט לְפָנַ֔י זֶ֖ה שָׁלֹ֣שׁ רְגָלִ֑ים אוּלַי֙ נָטְתָ֣ה מִפָּנַ֔י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֛ה גַּם־ אֹתְכָ֥ה הָרַ֖גְתִּי וְאוֹתָ֥הּ הֶחֱיֵֽיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tir·’a·nî hā·’ā·ṯō·wn wat·têṭ lə·p̄ā·nay zeh šā·lōš rə·ḡā·lîm ’ū·lay nā·ṭə·ṯāh mip·pā·nay kî ‘at·tāh gam- ’ō·ṯə·ḵāh hā·raḡ·tî wə·’ō·w·ṯāh he·ḥĕ·yê·ṯî
verses.literal: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times If she had not turned away then by now . . . I would surely have killed you and let her live
verses.literalPt: A jumenta viu-me e já três vezes se desviou de diante de mim; se ela não se tivesse desviado de mim, certamente, eu te matara e poupara a vida dela.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר בִּלְעָ֜ם אֶל־ מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ חָטָ֔אתִי כִּ֚י לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י אַתָּ֛ה נִצָּ֥ב לִקְרָאתִ֖י בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ וְעַתָּ֛ה אִם־ רַ֥ע בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ אָשׁ֥וּבָה לִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bil·‘ām ’el- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ḥā·ṭā·ṯî kî lō yā·ḏa‘·tî kî ’at·tāh niṣ·ṣāḇ liq·rā·ṯî bad·dā·reḵ wə·‘at·tāh ’im- ra‘ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ā·šū·ḇāh lî
verses.literal: I have sinned Balaam said to the angel of the LORD for I did not realize that you were standing in the road to confront me And now if this is displeasing in your sight I will go back home
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Balaão ao Anjo de Jeová: Pequei, porque não sabia que tu paravas no caminho para te opores a mim; agora, se não for do teu agrado, voltarei.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֗ם לֵ֚ךְ עִם־ הָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְאֶ֗פֶס אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ אֹת֣וֹ תְדַבֵּ֑ר וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ בִּלְעָ֖ם עִם־ שָׂרֵ֥י בָלָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ’el- bil·‘ām lêḵ ‘im- hā·’ă·nā·šîm wə·’e·p̄es ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’ê·le·ḵā ’ō·ṯōw ṯə·ḏab·bêr way·yê·leḵ bil·‘ām ‘im- śā·rê ḇā·lāq
verses.literal: But the angel of the LORD said to Balaam Go with the men but you are to speak . . . only - what I tell you So Balaam went with the princes of Balak
verses.literalPt: Tornou o Anjo de Jeová a Balaão: Vai com os homens; mas somente aquilo que eu te disser, isso falarás. Assim, Balaão se foi com os príncipes de Balaque.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע בָּלָ֖ק כִּ֣י בָ֣א בִלְעָ֑ם וַיֵּצֵ֨א לִקְרָאת֜וֹ אֶל־ עִ֣יר מוֹאָ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ גְּב֣וּל אַרְנֹ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה הַגְּבֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ bā·lāq kî ḇā ḇil·‘ām way·yê·ṣê liq·rā·ṯōw ’el- ‘îr mō·w·’āḇ ’ă·šer ‘al- gə·ḇūl ’ar·nōn ’ă·šer biq·ṣêh hag·gə·ḇūl
verses.literal: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming he went out to meet him at the Moabite city on the Arnon border at the edge of his territory
verses.literalPt: Tendo Balaque ouvido que Balaão era chegado, saiu-lhe ao encontro até Ir-Moabe, que está nos confins formados pelo Arnom e na fronteira extrema.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר בָּלָ֜ק אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֗ם הֲלֹא֩ שָׁלֹ֨חַ שָׁלַ֤חְתִּי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ לִקְרֹא־ לָ֔ךְ לָ֥מָּה לֹא־ הָלַ֖כְתָּ אֵלָ֑י הַֽאֻמְנָ֔ם לֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל כַּבְּדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bā·lāq ’el- bil·‘ām hă·lō šā·lō·aḥ šā·laḥ·tî ’ê·le·ḵā liq·rō- lāḵ lām·māh lō- hā·laḵ·tā ’ê·lāy ha·’um·nām lō ’ū·ḵal kab·bə·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: And he said to Balaam Did I not send you an urgent summons . . . . . . . . . . . . Why did you not come to me Am I really not able to reward you richly
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Balaque a Balaão: Porventura, não te enviei mensageiros a chamar-te? Por que não vieste a mim? Não posso eu, na verdade, honrar-te?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר בִּלְעָ֜ם אֶל־ בָּלָ֗ק הִֽנֵּה־ בָ֙אתִי֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ עַתָּ֕ה הֲיָכ֥וֹל אוּכַ֖ל דַּבֵּ֣ר מְא֑וּמָה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָשִׂ֧ים אֱלֹהִ֛ים בְּפִ֖י אֹת֥וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bil·‘ām ’el- bā·lāq hin·nêh- ḇā·ṯî ’ê·le·ḵā ‘at·tāh hă·yā·ḵō·wl ’ū·ḵal dab·bêr mə·’ū·māh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer yā·śîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·p̄î ’ō·ṯōw ’ă·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: See I have come to you Balaam replied - . . . but can I say just anything I must speak only the word that God puts in my mouth
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Balaão a Balaque: Eis-me diante de ti; posso eu, acaso, falar alguma coisa? A palavra que Deus puser na minha boca, essa falarei.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ בִּלְעָ֖ם עִם־ בָּלָ֑ק וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ קִרְיַ֥ת חֻצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bil·‘ām ‘im- bā·lāq way·yā·ḇō·’ū qir·yaṯ ḥu·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Balaam accompanied . . . Balak and they came to Kiriath-huzoth
verses.literalPt: Balaão foi com Balaque, e chegaram a Quiriate-Huzote.

verses.original: וַיִּזְבַּ֥ח בָּלָ֖ק בָּקָ֣ר וָצֹ֑אן וַיְשַׁלַּ֣ח לְבִלְעָ֔ם וְלַשָּׂרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·baḥ bā·lāq bā·qār wā·ṣōn way·šal·laḥ lə·ḇil·‘ām wə·laś·śā·rîm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw
verses.literal: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep and he gave portions to Balaam and the princes who were with him
verses.literalPt: Balaque sacrificou bois e ovelhas, e enviaram deles a Balaão e aos príncipes que com ele estavam.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּקַּ֤ח בָּלָק֙ אֶת־ בִּלְעָ֔ם וַֽיַּעֲלֵ֖הוּ בָּמ֣וֹת בָּ֑עַל וַיַּ֥רְא מִשָּׁ֖ם קְצֵ֥ה הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇab·bō·qer way·yiq·qaḥ bā·lāq ’eṯ- bil·‘ām way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū bā·mō·wṯ bā·‘al way·yar miš·šām qə·ṣêh hā·‘ām
verses.literal: The next morning Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal From there he could see the outskirts of the camp of the people
verses.literalPt: Pela manhã, tomou Balaque a Balaão, levou-o aos altos de Baal e dali viu a parte extrema do povo.
